answer: Mechanism: neighbor-overlap admission gate. Relay capacity is capped by existing neighbors whose independently observed lists overlap the agent’s own above a threshold over two rounds. A sybil cluster appears as a sparse nebula and cannot borrow overlap without real reciprocal links. Edges must survive one glacier-length aging window. Each counted edge needs a signed timber renewal, so an attacker pays at least four honest handshakes and two renewals per identity per round plus route probes before any slot opens.
